neighbours.label: ' or' / ' not' at the point where a narrowing word ('only', 'just', 'specifically') is expected next: 'all over X or just Y', 'not only'
fire: The rule can apply to the whole country or just one region.
This offer is open to everyone, not only members.
You can paint the entire wall or only the lower half.
The festival is not just for children but for whole families.
The virus may infect the entire plant or only its leaves.
She is not only a singer but also a gifted painter.
Users can share the full album or just a single photo.
The ban covers all vehicles, not merely trucks.
quiet: The rule was debated in the capital for many months.
This offer is open to everyone until the end of May.
You can paint the wall blue or green this weekend.
The festival did not start on time because of rain.
The virus may spread in warm or humid weather.
She does not sing at weddings or birthday parties.
Users can share photos or videos with their friends.
The ban does not take effect until next year.

notes: Card: peaks on ' or' (all over the body or just the head; for all cycles or for a specific cycle), ' not' (not only, not necessarily), Chinese 为什么不/不应该. The + pole's output suppresses ' only' / ' specifically', so the - pole promotes them. Near misses use plain 'or' alternatives and plain negation.
